pages.text: At dawn a site strikes if half its staff that can strike, two at least, are under 40 morale, or two have gone unpaid two dawns running. Interns, wolves and Nitwits are not counted.
The strikers stand in a ring round the clock with picket signs. The clock pulses red. They chant. Nothing is broken and nobody is hurt.$(br2)The $(l)Union Rep$() wears a red rosette.

$(l)Use$() the Rep with an empty hand for the demands: each striker's wage for every dawn it went unpaid, up to 7. Put it in the Pay Drawer, then $(l)Use$() a cake on the Rep. Everyone goes back at Content.

Left alone three loaded days, a strike collapses: everyone at 20. No strike in a world's first week, and none at that clock for three days after.$(br2)If the Board really carries "unionise" near a site that qualifies, it walks out at once.$(br2)$(o)Noggin & Sons respects its staff's right to organise. Noggin & Sons is also keeping a list.$()
